Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The South African players disperse after getting into a huddle.  The two openers for Pakistan, Imam-ul-Haq and Fakhar Zaman are out in the middle too. Kagiso Rabada to start with the ball. Here he goes...

Right! South Africa have made a decent recovery and they have got something to bowl at. They started poorly but managed to get themselves back on the back of the stand between Rassie and Miller. Now, it is up to their bowlers. Pakistan, on the other hand, would be disappointed with the overall performance. Because they had the hosts under the pump and now have a decent score to chase. They will need a good partnership early on. Join us for the run chase to know how things pan out.

It's the man of the moment, the man who got his maiden ODI century, Rassie van der Dussen is down for a quick chat. Rassie says that it is a special feeling. It is the first one of his career. He also says that he came at a time when the team was in trouble. He says that the wicket was a bit sticky but he says that the partnership with Miller was a good one as the runs were hard to come by and the boundaries had almost dried up. Further praises Miller for his run a ball knock of 50 off 50 balls. He further says that the pitch with being sticky was two-paced and there was spongy bounce too. He mentions that his role is to come in and take the team to a score that the bowlers can defend and he ends by saying that he hopes that they have put up a good score on the board and their bowlers can defend it.

The Pakistani bowlers were superb in the first Powerplay. They kept things really tight and got the rewards. Afridi struck twice in the 7th over of the match. Hasnain got rid of Bavuma soon. Ashraf got better of Klaasen in the 15th over to push the hosts on the back foot. However, once van der Dussen and Miller got themselves in, Pakistan allowed the pressure to release. Shadab bowled economically but Pakistan needed wickets from him in the middle overs but they never came. Babar gave the ball to everyone in the middle overs but none of them could break the stand between Rassie and Miller in time. Faheem bowled nicely in his 9-over spell, giving away just 25. Rauf and Afridi did pick up 2 wickets but they were expensive. Hasnain too bowled well but the only thing that will hurt Pakistan more is that their bowlers have allowed South Africa to get back in the game after having them 4 for just 55.

Asked to bat first, South Africa started well with the openers playing a few fine shots. However, once the opening stand was broken, the Proteas lost the way and lost 4 wickets in quick time. 33 from 0 became 55 for 4 in no time. However, van der Dussen and Miller combined together and put on a century-plus stand with both of them getting to their half-centuries. Miller fell after his half ton but Rassie continued and took the total over 200 as he added vital runs with Phehlukwayo. Rassie eventually registered his maiden ODI ton and powered South Africa to a very good score.

34 in the final 3 overs and it is an excellent recovery from South Africa to post a total in excess of 270. All credit to Rassie van der Dussen for his fabulous century. They were 4 down with not many runs on the board in the 15th over. And if they were told that they will get to over 260 from that point at the toss, they would take it happily. The visitors might feel that they have allowed the control to shift away.

FOUR! Bang! What a finish to the innings! Full and in the slot outside of, Rabada makes some room and then drives it through the gap. Piercing the two fielders at covers and mid off as the ball runs to the fence. SOUTH AFRICA END WITH 273/6 IN THEIR 50 OVERS!
A dot! Gold dist at this stage! Slower length ball outside off, Rabada slogs across the line but fails to get any wood on the ball there.
Slower short ball around off, Rassie pulls it off the inner half of the bat towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
And another single there! Low full toss on off, Rabada swings it towards wide mid off for a run.
Yorker around middle, Rassie squeezes it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Perfect start to the final over! Slower length ball around leg, Rassie van der Dussen sweeps it past short fine leg who is inside the circle to fetch a boundary.
Shaheen Afridi to bowl the final over of the innings.
Full and on middle, slogged to deep mid-wicket for a single. 14 runs off the penulimate over.
FOUR! Hammered! Full and in the slot with mid off in the circle., Rassie van der Dussen opens his arms and then sends it up and over mid off for a boundary at long off.
Full and around off, chipped down to long off for a single.
Swing and a miss! Rabada makes some room to go over the leg side but Rauf follows him to deny any room there. He still goes with the pull but connects with just the thin air.
Good length and wide outside off, stroked down to long on for a single.
WIDE! Length delivery but well and truly wide outside off, left alone. Wide called.

SIX! Powered away! Full and in the slot for Rassie van der Dussen to go for it and he does so with a powerful slog over deep mid-wicket to get half a dozen runs. Also, brings up the 250 for South Africa.
Who will bowl the penultimate over of the game? Haris Rauf it is.
Short of good length around middle, Rassie pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Short and around off, Rassie pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another length ball in the slot for Rabada to swing but this time the pace is cut off so the ball lands in the long on region for a single.

Rabada has issues with his willow. Some stoppage. A new bat comes out for Rabada but he is not happy with it. He asks a new one. The substitute fielder runs all the way to get him that. Rabada runs near the ropes and takes one from him with which he is happy.
FOUR! These are handy runs for South Africa! Length and going across Rababa, Kagiso lofts it straight and down towards long off. The ball bounces a couple of times before going over the ropes there.
Full and outside off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Length and around midlde, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Change in bowling! Mohammad Hasnain to bowl out. 9-2-43-1 are his numbers so far.

Slogged in the air... Caught.... Thrown back into the field of play... Just a single! Length ball around off, Rassie goes for a slog and powers it over mid-wicket. The ball seems to clear that man there but the fielder there leaps gets both hands to it. But he sees himself falling over the ropes so he throws the ball back into the field of play. Just a single taken.
Full and around middle, squeezed to long on for a single. Rauf leaps there but the ball evades him.

CENTURY FOR RASSIE! What a knock from a wonderful player. Maiden century for him in the ODIs. Walked with his team in a big, big trouble and hetook 11 balls to get off the mark but once he got himself in, he never looked back. A fantastic innings from Rassie. He gets there by punching this good length ball just outside off and strokes it through point. He removes his helmet and raises the bat to his mates in the dressing room.
Short of a length ball around off, punched to point for a quick single by Rabada to bring Rassie van der Dussen on strike.
Who is in next? It is Kagiso Rabada.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rauf gets the wicket again! Slower ball this time does the trick. Slower and outside off, Andile Phehlukwayo makes room and then looks to power it up and over covers but fails to get under the ball there. Also, the ball arrives late to lob off the bottom half of the bat and towards covers where Shadab Khan dives forward and takes the catch.
Length and around off, punched through to covers for a single. He is on 99!
BEATEN! Yorker and just outside off, Andile Phehlukwayo looks to dig it out but  fails to do so as the ball goes past the outside edge.
Full and on middle. Rassie looks to tuck it to the leg side but gets a soft leading edge towards covers for a single. on to 98 now!
Full and in the blockhole, Andile slogs it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Move to 97 now! Full and around off, Rassie strokes it down to mid off and takes a single.
Full and around off, Rassie clips it to mid-wicket off the front foot.
Full and outside off, Andile swing hard but gets it off the outside edge to third man for a single.
Short of a length and around off, Rassie punches it off the back foot and towards point this time. Good over this for South Africa as 13 runs come off it.
Good length and around middle, Andile punches it down to long on for a sngle.
Short of a length ball outside off, punched through covers for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Length and around off, Rassie goes down on one knee and then slogs it in the gap between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! Bang! Length ball outside off, Rassie van der Dussen waits for it and then sends it sailing over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. He moves into the 90s.
Full and wide outside off, this time as Rassie looks to stroke it to the off side but does not find the connection.
WIDE! Full and angled down leg, Rassie looks to go for the sweep over deep square leg but fails to do so. Wide called.
Length and around off, played to the on side for a single.
On off, Rassie strokes it to mid on.

Good length and around off, clipped to mid on for a single. Andile Phehlukwayo runs to the danger end and puts in a dive as the throw comes to the bowler's end where the fielder misses it. Risky single as that could have been curtains  for Andile Phehlukwayo had the fielder hit the stumps.

Misfield and FOUR! Not what Shaheen and Babar would have wanted! Fuller and around off, Andile Phehlukwayo goes for a whack over the off side but inside edges it past the leg stump and towards fine leg where Mohammad Hasnain makes a meal of it to let the ball through for a boundary.
Fuller and around off, Andile makes room and lofts it towards long on for a brace.

FOUR! Good start to the over! Full toss around midlde, Andile Phehlukwayo swing across and sends it towards deep mid-wicket where the fielder makes a desperate attempt to save it but fails to do so as he concedes a boundary.
Shaheen Afridi is back on. 7-1-34-2 from him so far.
Low full toss, pushed to mid off. They go for the quick single. The fielder there has a shy but he misses. Could've been risky.
Good comeback! Fullish and around off, hit back to the bowler. Hasnain collects and has a shy at the stumps.
FOUR! DRILLED! This should get Phehlukwayo going. Full and just outside off, he dances down the track and smashes it through the covers for a boundary.
Good length and around off, punched to mid off.
A simgle now! Fullish and just outside off, it is stroked through the covers for a single. 200 up for South Africa. This is a good recovery from them.
Mohammad Hasnain is back on. 7-2-24-1 from him so far.
4 dots in a row now for the Proteas. This is good pressure from the Pakistani bowlers. A back of a length ball around off, Rassie taps it on the off side.
Dot to end! A superb over from Faheem. Just 3 off it. Good length and around off, poked on the off side.
Another dot! Full and wide outside off, Phehlukwayo makes room and hits it hard but finds the cover fielder.
Just outside off on a good length, guided towards backward point for nothing.
Fuller and outside off, pushed through covers for one.
Good length and around off, kept out.
Faheem Ashraf is back on. 8-0-22-1 from him so far.
Good running! Back of a length ball around middle, it is pulled behind square on the leg side for two.
Single to end the 41st over. Yet another tidy over from Shadab. Floated on middle, Rassie sweeps it down to deep square leg for one.
Short and on middle, pulled straight to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flat and on the pads, Phehlukwayo looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad.
Flat and around off, this one is punched through the off side for one.
One more single. Full again and around middle, this time Phehlukwayo pushes it down to long off for one.
Tossed up and outside off, driven to long off for a single.
Powerplay 3 time! Now, Pakistan would be allowed to keep a maximum of 5 fielders outside the 30-yard circle till the innings end.
Single to end the over. Another 7-run over. Good length and around off, worked through mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and around middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Shortish and just outside off, this time Phehlukwayo finds the point region.
Drivel nicely but straight to the fielder. Fuller and outside off, stroked to the fielder at covers.
A single now! Another short ball from Rauf. This time van der Dussen mistimes his pull towards square leg for one.
FOUR! Pulled away. Poor start to the over from Rauf. A short ball down the leg side. Rassie pulls it wide of the keeper and into the fence.
Loopy ball around off, played to mid off. A tight over from Shadab. Just 1 off it.

One more dot. An appeal but turned down. Flat and around middle and leg, it lands and spins away. Andile looks to flick but misses. The keeper collects to his right and they appeal but not out says the umpire.
Flat and around off, kept out solidly.
Very full and on middle, flicked to mid-wicket for nothing.
Fired on the pads, worked on the leg side for nothing.
WIDE! Another one down the leg side. Phehlukwayo misses his flick again. Wided.
Full and around off and middle, pushed back to the bowler.
WIDE! Shadab begins the over with a wide one as he slips this one down the leg side. Andile looks to flick but misses.
Shortish and around off, Andile works it through mid-wicket for a single. 7 off the over.
Good length and just outside off, Phehlukwayo looks to punch it on the off side but ends up getting a bottom edge to the keeper.
Edgy again! Fullish and outside off, van der Dussen looks to drive but ends up getting an outside edge. The ball goes to third man for one.
Edgy! Good length and just outside off, Phehlukwayo looks to drive but the ball takes the thick outside edge and goes to third man for a run.
Landed around off on a length, played to the cover region.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, and Phehlukwayo gets the chance to free his arms. He powers it over point and finds the fence.
Big appeal for LBW but turned down. Tossed up and just outside off, Rassie goes for the sweep but misses to get hit on the pad. A loud appeal but turned down.
Two more for Rassie and he moves to 70. Flatter and outside off, Rassie strokes it wide of deep cover for a brace.
Flat and just outside off, stroked through the covers for one.
Shortish and around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Flat again and around off, forced through cover-point for one.
Flatter and just outside off, turning away. Rassie lets it be.
Andile Phehlukwayo is the new batsman in. Also, Shadab Khan is back on. 5-0-34-0 from him so far.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! An excellent catch from Rizwan. Rauf is fired up as well. Pakistan get the much-needed breakthrough. A length ball, it lands and angles away. Miller looks to drive it away from his body. He ends up getting an edge outside edge. Rizwan moves to his left and snaffles the chance low to his left. End of a fine knock from Miller but he would've loved to carry on. End of a successful over from Rauf.
A single now. Fullish and outside off, stroked through point for a single.
Short ball around middle, pulled to mid-wicket but straight to the fielder.
Back of a length ball just outside off, left alone.
FOUR! SHOT! Rassie once again plays with the field. Short ball around middle, Rassie gets in position and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Good length and around off, kept out.
Haris Rauf is back on. 5-0-34-0 from him so far.
Shortish and just outside off, punched straight to the cover fielder this time.
On middle, tucked on the leg side this time.
Floated around middle, played to mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and just outside off, forced through the covers for one.
FOUR! Nicely done! Rassie plays with the field here. Tossed up and outside off, Rassie gets down and sweeps it behind square on the leg side. The ball races away to the fence.
Floated around off, flicked to mid on.
Single to end the over. Shortish and just outside off, poked through point for one.
EDGY! Shortish and outside off, Rassie looks to pull but ends up getting a bottom edge. The ball goes over the stumps and it goes to the keeper.
Good length and around off, poked to point for nothing.

Good length ball around off, punched to deep cover for a single. That is 50 for Killer Miller. What a knock it has been from him. He struggled when South Africa toured earlier to Pakistan but here he is all pumped up and firing on all cylinders. The one thing that we have seen in his batting today is that he has played the ball purely on merit and has not taken any unwanted risk.
Short of good length and outside off, Rassie punches it through covers for a single.
Length and around off, Rassie blocks it out.
On off, played to sweeper cover for a single.
Floated on middle, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.

Miscommunication but all safe in the end. Floated on off, Rassie goes for the reverse sweep but gets it to backward point. Rassie takes off for a single and so does Miller. Rassie though is in two minds as he ran ahead and then backward but Miller was going towards the striker's end. The fielder collects the ball and throws it a bit wide of the bowler at his end thus allowing Rassie van der Dussen to make his ground safely there. A wicket goes abegging.

FOUR! Slapped hard! 50-up for Rassie van der Dussen. What a knock from him. He came at a time when his side needed someone stand and he does. Flat and outside off, Rassie cuts it through point and gets a boundary to bring up his milestone.
loopy on off, blocked to the off side.
Floated on off, Miller drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Full and around off, van der Dussen chips it in the air through point and gets a brace to bring up the 150 for South Africa.
Short and outside off, Rassie drops his wrists and then lets the ball through.
Short of good length around middle and leg, nudged to square leg for a brace.
Length and around off, Rassie looks to cut it off the back foot but the line is not right and he ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads.
Beauty! Length and outside off, bit of extra bounce too as Rassie looks to drive it on the up but is beaten on the outside edge.
Length and around off, watchfully played.
Flighted on off, eased down to long off for a single. A good first over from the debutant. Just 3 runs from it.
Flatter outside off, Rassie slaps it but straight to covers.
Floated around off, played to cover-point.
On off, eased to covers.
Tossed up on middle, tucked to the leg side for a single.
Floated outside off, Rassie runs it off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Debutant Danish Aziz comes onto bowl for the first time in his International career.
Length and on middle and leg, tucked to fine leg for a single.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Length and around off, played back to the bowler.
Short and wide outside off, carved towards sweeper cover for a single.
Length and around middle, clipped to square leg for a single.
Flatter and outside off, slapped through covers for a brace.

DRINKS!  South Africa have done well to get back into the game with this stand going strong. Pakistan need wickets to keep the South African charge. They would be aware of what Miller can do if he stays for long. While South Africa need him to continue the way he has. Faheem Ashraf is back on for now.
On off, played to covers.
Outside off, played to fine leg for a single.
Loopy on off, played back to the bowler.
Flatter and outside off, Miller slaps it through to deep cover for a single.
Flatter and on middle, nudged to square leg for a single.
On middle, clipped to square leg for a single.

Loopy around leg, Miller gets across his off stump and then looks to paddles it past the keeper and towards fine leg where the fielder mops it up to save a run. Three runs taken. Good running there. Wide called too. As there was no bat involved.
Length and around middle van der Dussen looks to fend it away to the leg side but is beaten get hit high on the pads. There is a stifled appeal but Hasnain aborts it quickly.
FOUR! Elegant! Short and wide outside off, Rassie van der Dussen this time tries to take the delivery and sends it through point for a boundary.
WIDE! Short and wide outside off, Rassie does not offer a shot to it. Wide called for height.
Short ball around off, Rassie goes for the pull but gets a toe-end of the bat. The ball hits the pads and then rolls to the off side.
Length and around off, Miller taps it to point off the back foot and takes a single this time.
Another length ball around off, Miller hops and fends it away from within the crease.
Length and around off, Miller hops and defends it to the off side.
On off,  Rassie runs it to backward point now.
On middle and leg, Miller tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on middle, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
On off, pushed to the off side.
FOUR! Runs starting to flow now! Full toss around off,  Rassie van der Dussen pulls it through square leg and fetches a boundary.
Loopy on leg, Miller gets to the pitch of the ball and then works it to square leg for a single.
Dot to end the 26th over. Short and wide outside off, van der Dussen punches it off the back foot but cannot get it past the man at point.
Shortish and on the body, worked behind square on the leg side for a run.
Fullish and around middle, pushed to mid on.
Two more! A length ball around middle, Miller works it wide of the man at deep square leg and scampers back for two. Good running from him.
Good length and around off and middle, Rassie tucks it through square leg for a single.
Mohammad Hasnain is back now. 5-2-13-1 from him so far.
Good length ball just outside off, pushed towards the cover region for a run.
Full on leg, eased down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and outside off, slapped through extra cover for a single.

Full and around off, Rassie taps it to covers and takes a quick single. The fielder there has a shy at the keeper's end but misses it as Rizwan fails to field it. The fielder behind him too cannot cut it off as the batsmen come back for the second due to the overthrow.
Floated around leg, worked towards the leg side for a single.
WIDE! Loopy but down leg, Miller misses his clip and the umpire gives it a wide.
Full and around off, driven down to long off for a single. 50-run stand is up between these two.
Floated on leg, Miller skips down the track and eases it down to long on for a single.
Good length and around off, Rassie eases it straight to the man at covers.
Short and angled across Rassie, van der Dussen sways away from the line of the ball as he drops his wrists too.
Length ball around middle Miller tucks it to the leg side and hurries for a quick run on offer.
Good length and angled on off, Miller is right behind the ball as he defends it out off the meat of the bat.
Full and around off, Miller punches it to covers.
In the air... Safe! Short ball around middle, Rassie goes for the pull but gets a top-edge. The ball falls in the vacant square leg region. The batsmen take a single.
Flatter around off, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy on off, driven down to long off for a single. 100-up for South Africa.
FOUR! Crunched! Flatter and wider outside off, Miller waits for the ball to come and then cuts it late and past point for a boundary.
Flighted on middle, worked away to square leg by Miller.
Low full toss around middle, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for just a single.
Tossed up on off, stroked down the ground where Khan goes to his right to field it in his followthrough.
Short of a good length and around off, punched on the up through covers for a single.
Low full toss on middle, Miller misses the freebie as he strokes it to the leg side for just a single. The ball there went off and inside edge and then in-between the pads.
Another delivery bowled on a length but the line is outside off and hence, Miller shoulders arms to it.
Length and around off, Miller blocks it out safely.
Short and around off and middle. Rassie pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Shaheen Afridi returns! 5-1-29-2 from him so far.
Length and around off, pushed to covers off the front foot by Rassie.
Floated on off, stroked through covers for a single. Just 5 runs from Shadab's first over.
On off, pushed to the bowler.
Floated around middle, Miller shuffles across and then paddles it fine towards fine leg for three runs as the fielder there mops it up.
On middle, nudged to mid-wicket.
Edgy! Tossed up on middle, Miller looks to clip it to the leg side but gets a soft leading edge which drops at covers.
Tossed up on leg, turned away to the leg side but off the pads. Leg bye taken.
Shadab Khan is on now.
FOUR! Poor line this time from Rauf and Miller capitalises it. Length and around leg, Miller shuffles across his off stump and then tickles it fine down to fine leg for a boundary.
Good length and around off, van der Dussen plays it off the back foot through point for a single.
Good length and around middle, punched back to the bowler.
WIDE! Length and well outside off and outside the tramline there. Rassie leaves it. Wide given.

Play and a miss! Short of good length and outside off, Rassie looks to flay it through the off side but the extra bounce means that the ball misses the outside edge. It was very close to getting the edge there.
WIDE! Short and around off, Rassie van der Dussen sways away from it. Wide called for height.
Length and around off, Miller punches it through cover-point and takes a single this time. Good batting this from the Southpaw.
FOUR! Dispatched! Short and wide outside off, Miller throws his bat at it and cuts it through backward point to fetch another boundary.
Just two runs from the over. Length and around off, Rassie defends it off the front foot again  and towards mid off.
Length and around off, played off the front foot towards covers by Rassie van der Dussen.
Full and around olf, Rassie strokes it back to the bowler who tumbles and fields it.
Short of good length around leg, Miller clips it towards square leg for  a single.
Length and around off, Miller clips it to mid-wicket.
Full and around off, pushed through point for a single.
Full and around off, Rassie drives it off the inner half of the bat to mid-wicket for a single.
Length and close to off, Miller pats it to point and takes a quick run on offer.
FOUR! Nicely played! Short and wide outside off, Miller cuts it through point for a boundary. This should get going Miller.
Good length and angled across Miller, David makes a watchful leave.
Length ball around off, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.
Length and on the pads, Rassie clips it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Dot to end the over. Just a run off it. Length ball around off, Miller stays back and pushes it towards short third man.
Full and wide outside off, driven to the cover region for nothing.
Landed around off on a length, Miller is solid in defense.
Fullish and around middle, this time Rassie pushes it wide of the man at mid on and takes a single.
Fuller and around off, kept out.
Shortish and just outside off, punched to the off side for nothing.
Single to end the over. Back of a length ball around off, pulled down to deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and outside off, driven nicely but straight to the cover fielder.
Full and just outside off, poked to through point for a single.
Shortish and outside off, left alone by Miller.
In the air... safe! Good length and around middle, Rassie looks to work it on the leg side. He ends up getting a leading edge. The ball goes in the air but lands well short of third man. A single.
Good length and just outside off, poked to point by Rassie.
FOUR! Miller is off the mark in style! A fuller ball outside off, he drives it through the covers. The cover fielder gives it a chase but fails to cut it off. 4 runs and a wicket from the over.
Landed around off on a length, Miller blocks.

Big appeal for LBW but turned down. No review from Pakistan. That was full and around middle, Miller looks to flick but misses. He gets hit in front of the wickets. They put in a loud appeal but it is turned down. Babar thinks about the review but they opt against it. Replays later show that Pakistan did right to not review as the ball was pitching outside leg.
Length ball around off, kept out.
Who comes out to bat now? David Miller, it is with the bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! Faheem strikes! A loose shot from Klaasen. After taking his time in the middle, he tried to break free as he saw width outside off. He ends up getting a nick behind. Rizwan makes no mistake. This was on a good length and outside off, Klaasen looked to cut it off the back foot but he ends up getting an outside edge. Number 4 falls for South Africa and the score is just 55. The Proteas are in big trouble here.
Fuller and around middle, driven to mid on for nothing.

DRINKS! A fine start for the visitors here. South Africa did look good with Markram and de Kock playing a few gorgeous shots. However, both departed within 2 balls and the Proteas came under pressure. Skipper Bavuma went for 1 soon to leave the team in tatters. Rassie and Klaasen are battling it out in the middle right now. However, the Pakistanis have kept things really tight for the duo so far. Afridi has got 2 while Hasnain got one. An interesting passage of play coming up...
Full and on the pads, Rassie flicks it wide of the man at deep square leg and takes two.
Fuller and around off, kept out.
And Klaasen is up and running. He will breathe easy now, a bit. A length ball on the pads, he flicks it to fine leg and takes one.

Klaasen still ona  duck here. A shortish ball around off, Klaasen looks to drop it on the off side and take a single but he ends up hitting it off the toe end. The ball drops near the off side and the bowler it quick to get to the ball.
A single! Length ball around middle and leg, it is clipped behind square on the leg side for a run.
Play and a miss! Lovely start to the over. Once again it lands just around off and the ball shapes away a touch. Rassie looks to play it on the off side but misses.
Another fine over from Faheem. Just one off it. Good length and around off, played back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, driven to the off side for nothing.
WIDE! Slipped down the leg side. Klaasen looks to flick but misses. Wided.
That is a jaffa! Klaasen couldn't have done much about it. A length ball, it is just outside off, Klaasen looks to punch it on the up but misses to connect and gets beaten for the outside edge.
Fullish and just outside off, poked to point this time.
Just outside off on a good length, punched to mid off for nothing.
Good length and around off, played back to the bowler.
Two more! Length ball around middle, van der Duseen tucks it through mid-wicket and scampers back for the 2nd. 6 off Rauf's first. 50 for South Africa.

FOUR! Gloriously driven! This should give Rassie some confidence and might settle the nerves for Klaasen too. Rauf overpitches it and bowls it wide outside off, Rassie leans into the shot and drills it wide of the man at mid off for a boundary.
Good start from Haris as well, so far. 4 dots in a row. Shortish and just outside off, punched to the cover region.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Good length and around off, pushed on the off side.
Beats the bat first ball. Just a bit of shape away. It lands just outside off and shapes away. Rassie looks to defend it but is beaten.
Change in bowling! Haris Rauf is on.
Haris Rauf to bowl now.
Dot to end another tight over. Tidy from Faheem in his first over. Good length and around middle, Klaasen tucks it to mid-wicket for nothing. 11 balls and he is yet to open his account.
Fullish and on middle, played back to the bowler.
Good length and around off, pushed to mid on this time.
Length ball around off, Klaasen blocks.

van der Dussen is up and running on the 11th ball after a slight fumble. A shortish ball just outside off, Rassie punches it wide of the point fielder. Imam dives to his right and makes a stop but fumbles a touch and they sneak a single.
Shortish and just outside off, poked to the off side.
Powerplay 2 time! Now Pakistan have the liberty to keep a maximum of 4 fielders outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Faheem Ashraf to inaugurate this passage of play.
Dot again. So, back-to-back maidens for Pakistan. A fuller ball just outside off, it is hit straight to mid off once again. Quality Powerplay 1 from Pakistan. 3 wickets in it for the visitors.
Fullish and just outside off, Klaasen looks to drive but the ball takes the toe end and goes to mid off.
Full outside off, played to point.
Full and around off, punched off the back foot and to the bowler.
Length and coming in with the angle, Klaasen looks to clip it to the leg side but gets beaten high on the pads. An appeal is made but nothing doing says the umpire.
Full and around off, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Fuller and around off, pushed to the cover region. A maiden from Afridi.

Put down! That was a tough chance though. A length ball, angling away after landing just outside off. Rassie looks to force it on the off side but ends up getting a thick outside edge. The ball flies to the right side of Asif Ali. He dives that side and tries to catch. He gets both hands but fails to hold on.
Length ball around middle, kept out.
Another full ball around off, once again, Rassie blocks it back to Afridi.
Fullish and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Good length and around off, Rassie looks to push it on the off side but ends up getting it off the inner half and towards mid-wicket.

NOT OUT! Klaasen survives! He rightly uses the review. Full and around off, Klaasen looks to defend it but is beaten to get hit on the pads. Hasnain goes up in an appeal straightaway and the umpire raises his finger too. Klaasen though takes the review immediately. The replays come on and the Ultra Edge detects a spike. So, the on-field decision needs to be overturned. Had there been no inside edge then Klaasen would have been plumb there.

DRS TIME! Klaasen has been given out LBW but he has gone for the review. Let's see the replay. Ultra Edge detects big spike. That is why Klaasen didn't even discuss with his partner and went for the review.
Heinrich Klaasen joins Rassie van der Dussen in the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! Pakistan are all over South Africa. Not the best of the deliveries from Hasnain but he and Pakistan won't mind if it gets them the wicket. A bitter outing for the new skipper. Short and wide outside off, Bavuma stays on the back foot and looks to uppercut it over third man but ends up slicing it towards third man. Afridi does not have to move an inch as the ball comes straight to him and he takes it gleefully.
Short of a length and around off, punched off the back foot to covers.

An appeal and the umpire is unmoved! Full and sliding on the pads once again, Bavuma goes for the flick but misses it as the ball rolls towards square leg off the pads. A leg bye taken as the bowler appeal for LBW but the umpire is unmoved.
He is off the mark! Full and on the pads, Bavuma flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Good length and well outside off, Bavuma is not going to go after it. He makes a leave. He knows he has ample time in the game to get going.
Good length and around off, van der Dussen pushes it to mid off now. End of an excellent over from Afridi. He gave away 7 runs and took two wickets.
Fuller length ball around off, Rassie plays it off the front foot solidly.
What walks out to bat now? Rassie van der Dussen is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! A fabulous take there! South Africa lose both their openers in the span of 3 deliveries. Another short of a length ball from Afridi, the ball stops a bit though into the surface as Markram looks to clip it to the leg side. He though is early as the ball goes off the outer half of the bat and over the leaping Afridi and towards mid on. Faheem Ashraf runs ahead and just about in time to get the hands under the ball to pouch the catch. The thrid umpire is called for to check for clean catch and after a few replays the umpires rules it as out.
SIX! Good use of the Free Hit! Short and around middle, Markram reads the length early and makes the required adjustments before pulling it flat over deep square leg for a biggie.

Is that a clean catch? Faheem is not sure. The umpires get together and take it upstairs. The soft signal is out. Looks like the fingers are under the ball or is it? This looks really close. Given out because of the soft signal. Big, big wicket.
Short of a good length and around off, Markram punches it to covers this time. No Ball called as Afridi oversteps there. Free Hit loading...
Who is in next? It is the skipper, Temba Bavuma.

OUT! CAUGHT! Quinton de Kock again throws his wicket away to a rash shot. He was going along nicely but the urge to overpower Afridi brings his downfall. Shaheen again keeps it on a back of a length and outside off, de Kock goes for a hit downtown and this time connects too. He though fails to get it off the middle as the ball goes high in the air but does not go the distance as it comes down near long off where Babar Azam runs back from mid off and pouches it.
Play and a miss! Length and around off de Kock dances down the track and makes room to go downtown but is undone by  the extra bounce as the ball goes past the outside edge.

An appeal there from Hasnain but the umpire is unmoved. Length and coming in with the angle there, Aiden looks to clip it to the leg side but gets hit high on the thigh pad. Hasnain puts in an appeal but nothing from the umpire there. South Africa slowly picking up the scoring pace there.
Good comeback from Hasnain. Short ball around off, Markram watches it and then sways away from it.
FOUR! Cracked! Hear the sound of the bat! Short of a length ball around off, Markram punches the ball on the up and through the covers as the ball whizzes to the fence.
FOUR! Exquisite! Slightly overpitched and around off, Markram stays firm and then punches the ball past mid off and into the fence at long off for a boundary.
Good length and around off, Aiden plays it to the leg side this time off the inner half of the bat.
Short of a good length  and around off, Markram punches it straight to the man at point.
FOUR! SHOT! Slapped! Shortish and just outside off, de Kock slaps this through mid on and it goes to the fence. Big over for South Africa as they get 10 off it.
Length and around middle, flicked to mid-wicket for nothing.

SIX! BANG! There's that de Kock special. He loves playing this stroke. We have seen him play these in the Indian T20 League and he unleashes one here as well. A back of a length ball angled in from middle, de Kock moves across and just helps it over the fine leg fence via a pull for half a dozen.
Drilled but straight to the cover-point fielder. Full again and wide again from Shaheen. De Kock makes a bit of a room and nails the drive but it goes straight to the fielder at cover-point.
Good stop from Imam. Fuller and outside off, driven wide of the point fielder where Imam makes a stop diving to his left.
Edgy! Good length and around off, de Kock looks to defend but the ball takes the bottom edge and goes behind past the sticks.
Dot to end the 4th over. Fullish and just around off, Markram gets on the front foot and pushes it to the cover region.
FOUR! Solid this time! This one should get going Markram. A shortish ball just outside off, Markram punches it on the up and it races to the fence through the covers.
Nicely driven but for nothing. Fuller and outside off, Aiden drives it hard but straight to the man at point.
One more dot for Markram. Fullish ball just outside off, punched to mid off.
Just outside off on a length, pushed to mid on.
Good length and outside off, pushed to the cover region.
Hasnain loses his run up there. He runs in and looks to bowl but slips near the landing area.

FOUR! Crunched! Wide outside off and a bit shortish too. De Kock slams it through covers and the ball goes to the fence. The fielder there did put in a dive to his right and got hand to it but failed to stop. Good finish to the over. 10 off it.
Good length and around off, watchfully blocked.
Two more! A short ball just outside off, de Kock goes for the pull. He doesn't time it that well but it goes over the man at mid-wicket. Two taken.

FOUR! And de Kock is away and he is away in style! Lovely stroke! A fullish ball outside off, de Kock nails the drive through the covers and the ball races away to the fence. First boundary of the game.
Good length and around off, poked to the short third man region. 12 dots in a row so far between the 2 batters.
Full and just outside off, pushed to the right side of the bowler. Afridi stops it nicely.
A dot and it is a maiden. A perfect start from Hasnain. A fullish ball just around off, pushed to the cover region off the splice of the bat. Top over first up.
Another dot! 5 in a row. Can Hasnain deliver a maiden first up? Just outside off on a length, pushed to the off side.
This one is in the channel outisde off. It moves away a touch too. Markram covers his stumps and lets it go behind.
Three dots to begin from Hasnain. A good length ball just outside off, Markram looks to work it on the leg side but he ends up getting it off the top half towards mid off.
Good length and outside off, punched to point for nothing.
Hasnain is on the money straightaway. A length ball, it lands just around off and moves away. Markram stays back and forces it on the off side.
Who will bowl from the other end? Mohammad Hasnain to bowl from the other end.
Dot to end the opening over. Tidy stuff from Afridi. Good length and just outside off, de Kock punches it off the back foot but finds the cover fielder. Just 2 from the first over.
Fullish and around off, this one is played back to the bowler.
Landed around off on a good length, de Kock this time comes on the front foot and blocks solidly.

Lovely delivery against the left-hander. A length ball around middle, it comes back in. De Kock looks to work it on the leg side but misses to get hit high on the pad. A mild LBW appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Markram is underway! A fullish ball around off and middle, Markram tucks it wide of the man at mid-wicket and takes one to open his account.
Afridi gets the line and length right this time. It is just outside off on a good length, Markram blocks it off the back foot.
WIDE! Afridi slips the first ball of the game down the leg side. Markram looks to flick but misses. The umpire wides it.

We are all set to begin. The Pakistan players are out on the field and they are followed by the two South African openers, Quinton de Kock and Aiden Markram. Shaheen Afridi to start with the ball. Here we go...
Pakistan (Playing XI)  Imam-ul-Haq, Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam (C), Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Danish Aziz (ON ODI DEBUT), Asif Ali, Shadab Khan, Faheem Ashraf, Shaheen Afridi, Mohammad Hasnain, Haris Rauf.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK), Aiden Markram, Temba Bavuma (C), Rassie van der Dussen, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, Andile Phehlukwayo, Kagiso Rabada, Anrich Nortje, Lungi Ngidi, Tabraiz Shamsi.
Toss - Time for the toss. The two captains are out in the middle. Up goes the coin and it lands in the favour of Pakistan. THEY ELECT TO FIELD!

Time for yet another series, this time South Africa are the hosts and Pakistan are touring the rainbow nation for the limited-overs series. The tour starts with the ODIs and ends with the T20Is. Earlier in January South Africa toured Pakistan where they lost both the Test series as well as the T20I series. With a change of guard, this time for the Proteas will their fortunes change as they look to fine-tune their skills ahead of the T20I World Cup. While Pakistan too would look to fix their flaws in their batting and come out stronger at the end of the series. Who will take the lead in the 3-match ODI series? Join us as the toss comes your way in a short while.
